title: Kenyan Iced Coffee
community: Urban Kenya — the café drink that celebrates Kenya's world-class beans
author: Chef Amina Hassan

meta.cookingMethod: Cold Brew or Brewed and Chilled

desc: Kenyan Iced Coffee — cold brew or chilled brewed Kenya AA or Nyeri single-origin coffee over ice, with milk and honey. The drink that makes the world understand why Kenyan coffee commands a premium — fruit-forward, bright, and complex even over ice.
longDesc: Kenyan coffee is the most celebrated in the world among specialty coffee enthusiasts — the volcanic soils of Nyeri, Kirinyaga, Murang'a, and the slopes of Mount Kenya produce beans with extraordinary fruit brightness, black currant notes, and complex floral aromas. Served as iced coffee, these qualities shine through with particular clarity. This is the drink that converts people to single-origin coffee.
ingredients: 4 tbsp coarsely ground Kenya AA or Nyeri coffee
4 shots strong brewed Kenyan espresso or filter coffee — cooled
½ cup cold whole milk or plant milk
equipment: Cold brew jar or coffee maker
steps: Cold brew: combine coarsely ground coffee and cold water in a jar. Stir. Refrigerate 12—18 hours. Strain.
Pour 150ml cold brew or chilled coffee over ice.
Pour cold milk over — it creates a beautiful layered effect.
Stir gently just before drinking — or drink in layers.
chefTips: Cold brew makes the finest iced coffee — the extended cold extraction produces a smooth, bright concentrate with no bitterness.
Use Kenya AA or Nyeri single-origin — the quality difference is dramatic and the reason to make this at all.
The honey complements Kenyan coffee's natural fruit notes better than sugar.
commonMistakes: Using mediocre coffee — defeats the purpose.
Not enough ice — iced coffee warms quickly.
cookingScience: Cold brew extracts different compounds than hot brewing. At cold temperatures, fewer bitter acids and more sweet, fruit-forward compounds extract — this is why cold brew is smoother and less bitter than hot brew chilled. Kenyan coffee's natural acidity, which produces its characteristic brightness, is particularly well-suited to cold extraction.
sustainabilityTips: Direct-trade Kenyan single-origin coffee ensures farmers in Nyeri, Kirinyaga, and other growing regions receive fair prices for extraordinary beans.
storage: Cold brew concentrate keeps refrigerated for 2 weeks.
healthBenefits: Coffee is one of the richest sources of antioxidants in the human diet.
Kenyan coffee specifically contains high levels of chlorogenic acids with anti-inflammatory properties.
Provides natural caffeine for mental clarity.
culturalNote: Kenyan iced coffee is a statement about one of Kenya's greatest agricultural achievements. Kenyan coffee is sought by the world's finest roasters — when served as iced coffee in a Nairobi café, it is the country tasting its own excellence.
